stdin_conflict: The master password and entry input cannot share stdin
unknown_database: The database is not open in this session
session_only: This command requires an interactive session
session_ready: Taypeer session. Use 'db open', 'db create' or --help. Ctrl-D exits.
help_lifecycle: Review exact selections and confirm trash, restoration or permanent purge.
help_pending: Inspect and explicitly recover late changes of purged objects.
help_tree: Show the retained tree, placement conflicts and causal review heads.
help_group_move: Move a group to a destination and sibling position.
help_group_resolve: Resolve reviewed placement/name alternatives using a GroupMove JSON document.
help_group_clone: Clone an active subtree with fresh identities throughout.
help_group_trash: Prepare deletion of this exact subtree; submit the result to 'trash confirm'.
help_entry_move: Move an entry; optionally resolve alternatives at reviewed heads from JSON.
help_entry_trash: Prepare deletion of this entry; submit the result to 'trash confirm'.
help_generation: Choose a reviewed generation after concurrent recoveries, using JSON input.
help_trash_list: List retained trash objects, including deletion conflicts.
help_trash_prepare: Prepare an exact selection at current heads without changing data.
help_trash_confirm: Confirm precisely a reviewed PreparedLifecycle JSON document.
help_trash_show: Inspect a retained generation with protected fields hidden.
help_trash_reveal: Reveal one inspected variant selected by target, field and origins in JSON.
help_pending_list: List unprocessed late changes with original source provenance.
help_pending_show: Inspect an original source with protected fields hidden.
help_pending_restore: Restore the source under its public ID in a fresh generation.
help_pending_clone: Clone the source into a new object.
help_pending_recover: Submit a RecoveryRequest JSON document with explicit field/name choices.
help_pending_reveal: Reveal one source variant selected by target, field and origins in JSON.
help_attachment: Manage streamed attachments and export selected contents.
help_icon: Choose stored icons or explicitly download images and favicons.
help_appearance: Edit explicit entry colors in the shared draft.
help_storage: Inspect quota and reclaim unreachable binary contents.
help_target_draft: Use the active draft without confirming the entry.
help_binary_list: List stored binary references, variants and availability.
help_attachment_add: Stream a selected file into a new attachment.
help_attachment_rename: Rename an attachment, preserving identity and contents.
help_attachment_replace: Replace contents; the previous version remains in history.
help_attachment_remove: Remove an attachment from the current entry or draft.
help_binary_export: Export the selected blob to --output; replacement requires --overwrite.
help_icon_set: Set a Lucide key or default.
help_icon_file: Validate and store an icon from a selected file.
help_icon_url: Explicitly download an image from HTTP(S), including local addresses.
help_icon_favicon: Download the favicon of --url or the current entry URL.
help_group_favicons: Download missing icons for group entries; --recursive includes descendants.
help_appearance_set: Set #RRGGBB[AA] colors or explicitly clear them to follow the theme.
help_storage_usage: Show attachment quota, retained contents, drafts and backups separately.
help_storage_gc: Atomically omit unreachable contents while retaining history, conflicts and sources.
icon_network_boundary: A public site cannot redirect icon loading to an internal address.
icon_error: The image could not be loaded or validated.
missing_blob: This source is waiting for its binary contents.
